moment_types.name: two_point_made
moment_types.description: A two-point field-goal attempt visibly scores.

moment_types.name: two_point_miss
moment_types.description: A two-point field-goal attempt visibly misses.

moment_types.name: three_point_made
moment_types.description: A shot from beyond the three-point arc visibly scores.

moment_types.name: three_point_miss
moment_types.description: A shot from beyond the three-point arc visibly misses.

moment_types.name: offensive_rebound
moment_types.description: The shooting team gains control after its missed shot.

moment_types.name: defensive_rebound
moment_types.description: The defending team gains control after an opponent missed shot.

moment_types.name: steal
moment_types.description: A defender intercepts or disrupts opponent possession and gains team control.

moment_types.name: turnover
moment_types.description: A team loses possession through an error, violation, or opponent steal; not a normal shot/rebound.

moment_types.name: block
moment_types.description: A defender visibly deflects an opponent shot attempt.

moment_types.name: assist
moment_types.description: A pass directly leads to a teammate made field goal; both pass and made shot must be supported.

moment_types.name: made_field_goal
moment_types.description: A visibly made field goal with unknown point value.

moment_types.name: missed_field_goal
moment_types.description: A visibly missed field goal with unknown point value.
